text: dsh-danus 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的数学证明协作插件套件。它通过 bundle 挂载角色门控工具、worker swarm 和独立验证服务，并为浏览器控制台提供 client 入口。主要功能包括共享记忆与已验证事实检索、提交证明并由冷启动 verifier 判定、管理 worker 项目和任务，以及把事实图整理为 LaTeX 论文或进度报告。适合需要并行探索、保留可追溯证明并整理研究结果的数学研究者。需要 Node.js 20 及可用的 DSH headless profile；项目数据保存在本地目录。

dsh-danus adds multi-agent mathematical proof workflows to DSH. Its role-gated tools coordinate workers, search shared memory, and submit proofs to an independent verifier. Verified facts can be shaped into LaTeX papers. Requires Node.js 20 and a DSH headless profile.

dsh-danus 的功能「角色门控的证明工具」：按 worker、main、verifier 等角色显示不同工具，并将未知角色回退为只读 verifier 权限。通过 DSH tools 调用记忆和事实检索、提交或撤销事实。
dsh-danus 的功能「独立证明验证」：worker 提交 statement 和 proof 后先经过确定性预检，再由新启动的 headless verifier 会话返回判定结果。
dsh-danus 的功能「worker swarm 管理」：主 agent 可创建项目和 worker 名册、覆盖分配任务，并启动、检查或停止 worker 轮次。
dsh-danus 的功能「可追溯事实图」：通过验证的命题保存为带前驱关系的事实节点，并可按内容生成稳定标识，供后续搜索和依赖追踪。
dsh-danus 的功能「论文编写工具」：提供读取目标事实子图、从已验证事实生成论文、审查和核验参考文献等工具，支持围绕事实图整理研究成果。
dsh-danus 使用前须知：证明核验会通过 DSH headless profile 启动独立会话；部署时需要配置可用的 headless profile。

dsh-danus README · dsh-danus：**Verifier-gated multi-agent mathematical proof search, native to DeepSeek Harness (DSH).** A swarm of autonomous worker agents proves; a cold-start verifier is the sole authority on correctness; verified results accumulate in a content-addressed fact graph — the only source of truth; the finished work renders into a LaTeX paper or a human progress report.
dsh-danus README · dsh-danus：Everything runs as DSH plugins (TypeScript) on your own model endpoints — no Python, no external MCP processes, cross-platform (Windows included).

dsh-danus README · What it does：- **Truth layer** — a content-addressed, cascade-revocable fact graph (`fact_id = SHA-256(statement, proof, predecessors, ...)[:16]`), plus three-tier memory: worker-local → project global memory (BM25-searchable findings) → verified facts. Only the fact graph is truth.
- **Role-gated tools** — six tools (`gm_add`, `gm_search`, `fact_submit`, `fact_search`, `fact_revoke`, `search_arxiv_theorems`) with a structural permission table: the orchestrating *main* agent has no `fact_submit`, the *verifier* is read-only, unknown roles fail closed.
- **Cold-start verifier** — every submission runs deterministic prechecks (vacuousness thresholds + P1/P3/P5 hard prohibitions), then a **fresh, isolated headless judge session** decides: `correct = no critical errors and no gaps`. Rejections come back with repair hints; verdicts are always traced to global memory.
- **Worker swarm** — detached per-worker round loops (`danus-worker` profile), one fresh headless session per round resuming from persisted memory; graceful `.stop`, deadlines, round caps, stuck detection, cross-platform process supervision.
- **Orchestration tools** — `danus_new / assign / start / status

dsh-danus README · Verification：- **102/102 tests green** (`pnpm test`), including byte-exact golden vectors generated by the original implementation.
- Live end-to-end on a real DSH install: project scaffolding → worker round → `fact_submit` → independent cold-start judge → fact `cefabd883755ac88` in the graph.
- `PARITY.md` maps every behavior to the original, item by item.
